title: African Flags Quiz: 20 Flags to Identify
description: Take our quiz on the flags of Africa: identify 20 national flags from Egypt, Nigeria and Kenya to Botswana and Cape Verde. Free and fun.
h1: African Flags Quiz: Can You Name These Flags?
intro: Africa's flags are full of color and meaning, from the green, gold and red of Ethiopia to the sweeping design of South Africa. In this African flags quiz, you will see 20 national flags, one at a time, and must choose the right country. The first questions use widely seen flags, then the quiz moves on to look-alikes such as those of Ghana, Cameroon and Ethiopia, and ends with island nations and southern African flags. You get about five seconds per question, so go with your gut. A short explanation after each answer shares something about the flag's design. Let's see how well you know Africa.

faq: Why do so many African flags use green, yellow and red?

These colors, called the Pan-African colors, trace back to Ethiopia's flag. Ethiopia was one of the few African countries to keep its independence through the colonial era, so its colors became a symbol of freedom. Ghana, Senegal, Mali and many other countries adopted them after independence.
How many countries are in Africa?

Africa has 54 countries recognized by the United Nations. This quiz covers 20 of their flags, and some questions feature easily confused neighbors, such as Tunisia and Algeria, or Ghana and Cameroon. Africa also includes island nations, such as Madagascar, Cape Verde and the Seychelles, whose flags are among the trickiest to identify.
How can I tell similar African flags apart?

Look for the details. Ghana has a black star on red, gold and green stripes, Ethiopia has a blue disc, and Cameroon has a star on the red stripe. Some flags, like Mali and Senegal, differ mainly by the green star, so pay attention to small emblems.
